描述_EN: the finished textiles were probably brought via chinese junks sailing to the philippines. judging from its shape, this fragment may have been taken from a roman catholic priest's chasuble. the crimson silk ground indicates that the vestment would probably have been worn on the feast day of a martyr. the repeat pattern of double-headed eagles over a stylised vase may have been intended to be an emblem adopted by the order of st augustine under hapsburg patronage. this vestment was probably woven in the east, in macau, for augustinian missionaries stationed in the philippines. the original emblem is the royal hapsburg eagles standing over a cardinal's hat (probably symbolising the authority of the crown and the church), which rests over the augustinian crest of a heart pierced with arrows.
描述_ZN: 成品纺织品可能是通过中国的船运到菲律宾的。 从它的形状来看，这块碎片可能是来自罗马天主教牧师的袍子。 深红色的丝绸地表明这件衣服可能是在殉道者的节日里穿的。 双头鹰在花瓶上的重复图案可能是圣奥古斯丁教团在哈布斯堡的赞助下采用的标志。 这件衣服可能是在东方的澳门为驻扎在菲律宾的奥古斯丁传教士编织的。 最初的徽记是哈布斯堡皇家老鹰站在红衣主教的帽子上（可能象征着王室和教会的权威），帽子放在奥古斯丁的心形徽章上，上面扎着箭。
